description: Editorial spoiler placement is separate from factual release status. Related content can be withheld without asserting that it is unreleased.

entries.reason: Named in version 31; version 32 adds its full reward table, a Christmas town style and three villagers, all switched on for version 32. The server picks the running season, and this one hasn’t been announced or seen in game.
highlights: Holiday-dressed Playground, Winter Cabin, Bonfire, Tailor, Winter Pub and Fondue Bar as rewards.
A Christmas town style: on Evergreen maps the trees turn snowy, with leaves drifting down from Ash and Pine.
Holiday villagers with their own hair and winter outfits, and holiday lighting for day and night in every biome.
Its name and leaderboard were translated into every language in version 32; in version 31 they were English only.
Next after Greek in the game’s season order.

entries.reason: A tournament season in the game files that hasn’t been seen in game. Greek is the season added in version 31; Rural, Nordic and Mesoamerican have run.
highlights: Egyptian-styled Lumberjacks’ Base, Smoothie Stand, Desert Home, Market, Well and Press as rewards.
An Egyptian palette for your town and an Egyptian look for your villagers.
Complete in the files since version 28.

highlights: Imperial-styled Plank House, Farm, Beehive, Paper Mill, Orchard and Brewery as rewards.

entries.reason: Added in version 31 as a season name and a Game Center leaderboard only; still no rewards, town style or villagers in version 32. Not seen in game.
highlights: Only a name and a Game Center leaderboard so far.
